widget.title: About

text.content:
Use this dashboard to monitor your invocations of [Google-managed foundational models](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/models).

Use the **Throughput**, **Latency** and **Errors** sections to view application golden signals and troubleshoot service health.

The **Tokens** section provides views into your consumption, which allows you to monitor costs and inspect whether you are approaching quota limits. If you rely on [Provisioned Throughput](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/provisioned-throughput#metrics), filter the `request_type` parameter to `dedicated` to track your provisioned token throughput.

**1-second resolution from logs.** Charts with a dropdown in their header offer a *1-second resolution from logs* option next to the default *1-minute resolution from metrics*: Model requests per second (QPS), Token count by model, Model invocations by response code, Model invocations error rate (%), and the Tokens section charts, which add Token throughput by model and served traffic type. The 1-second options read inference request logs for Gemini and Claude models. To see them, turn on inference request logging for the project and upgrade its _Default log bucket to Observability Analytics; logging incurs Cloud Logging charges. Points are 1 second apart when the window is 200 seconds or less. [Learn how to turn on logging](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/capabilities/inference-metadata-logging).

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: WITH final AS (WITH e AS (SELECT timestamp, IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), '') AS model, IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.location), '') AS location, SAFE_CAST(RTRIM(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.requestDuration), 's') AS FLOAT64) * 1000 AS latency_ms, CASE IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.error.code) AS INT64), 0) WHEN 0 THEN '200' WHEN 1 THEN '499' WHEN 3 THEN '400' WHEN 4 THEN '504' WHEN 5 THEN '404' WHEN 6 THEN '409' WHEN 7 THEN '403' WHEN 8 THEN '429' WHEN 9 THEN '400' WHEN 10 THEN '409' WHEN 11 THEN '400' WHEN 12 THEN '501' WHEN 14 THEN '503' WHEN 16 THEN '401' WHEN 2 THEN '500' WHEN 13 THEN '500' WHEN 15 THEN '500' ELSE 'other' END AS response_code FROM `cloud-llm-preview1.global._Default._Default` WHERE log_id = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request' AND resource.type = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/PublisherModel' AND IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.method), '') IN ('GENERATE_CONTENT', 'STREAM_GENERATE_CONTENT', 'RAW_PREDICT', 'STREAM_RAW_PREDICT') AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), ''), r'^(gemini|claude)')), el AS (SELECT timestamp, CONCAT(model, ' ', location) AS model FROM e), ranked AS (SELECT model, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, model) AS rk FROM el GROUP BY model), s AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(el.timestamp, SECOND) AS second, IF(ranked.rk <= 10, el.model, 'other') AS model, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM el JOIN ranked USING (model) GROUP BY second, model), w AS (SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 200 THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 2000 THEN 10 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 12000 THEN 60 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 60000 THEN 300 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 180000 THEN 900 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 720000 THEN 3600 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 4320000 THEN 21600 ELSE 86400 END AS b FROM s) SELECT TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(second), b) * b) AS bucket, model, SUM(requests) / MAX(b) AS requests_per_second FROM w GROUP BY bucket, model ORDER BY bucket, model) SELECT bucket, model, requests_per_second FROM final UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), SECOND) AS bucket, IF((SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM `cloud-llm-preview1.global._Default._Default` WHERE log_id = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request' AND resource.type = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/PublisherModel' AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), ''), r'^(gemini|claude)')), 'No requests in this window.', 'No inference request logs in this window. Turn on logging to see 1-second data.') AS model, 0 AS requests_per_second FROM (SELECT 1) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM final)

IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.rawPredictDetails.usageMetadata.cache_read_input_tokens) AS INT64), 0) AS c_read, IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.rawPredictDetails.usageMetadata.cache_creation_input_tokens) AS INT64), 0) AS c_write, IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.rawPredictDetails.usageMetadata.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens) AS INT64), 0) AS c_write_1h, IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.rawPredictDetails.usageMetadata.output_tokens) AS INT64), 0) AS c_out FROM `cloud-llm-preview1.global._Default._Default` WHERE log_id = 'STREAM_GENERATE_CONTENT', 'RAW_PREDICT', 'STREAM_RAW_PREDICT') AND IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), '') != 'count-tokens' AND severity = 'INFO' AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), ''), r'^(gemini|claude)')), u AS (SELECT timestamp, CONCAT(model, ' ', location) AS model, IF(is_google, g_prompt + g_tool + g_out + g_thoughts, c_in + c_read + c_write + c_out) AS tokens FROM r), ranked AS (SELECT model, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(tokens) DESC, model) AS rk FROM u GROUP BY model), s AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(u.timestamp, SECOND) AS second, IF(ranked.rk <= 10, u.model, 'other') AS model, SUM(u.tokens) AS tokens FROM u JOIN ranked USING (model) GROUP BY second, model), w AS (SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 200 THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 2000 THEN 10 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 12000 THEN 60 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 60000 THEN 300 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 180000 THEN 900 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 720000 THEN 3600 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 4320000 THEN 21600 ELSE 86400 END AS b FROM s) SELECT TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(second), b) * b) AS bucket, model, SUM(tokens) / MAX(b) AS tokens_per_second FROM w GROUP BY bucket, model ORDER BY bucket, model) SELECT bucket, model, tokens_per_second FROM final UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), SECOND) AS bucket, IF((SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM `cloud-llm-preview1.global._Default._Default` WHERE log_id = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request' AND resource.type = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/PublisherModel' AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), ''), r'^(gemini|claude)')), 'No requests in this window.', 'No inference request logs in this window. Turn on logging to see 1-second data.') AS model, 0 AS tokens_per_second FROM (SELECT 1) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM final)

LOGICAL_OR(traffic_type = 'PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT') OVER (PARTITION BY model) AND IF(is_google, request_type NOT IN ('dedicated', 'shared'), request_type = 'batch') THEN 'PT_SPILLOVER' ELSE SECOND) <= 2000 THEN 10 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 12000 THEN 60 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 60000 THEN 300 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 180000 THEN 900 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 720000 THEN 3600 WHEN SUM(consumed) / MAX(b) AS consumed_tokens_per_second FROM w GROUP BY bucket, model ORDER BY bucket, model) SELECT bucket, model, consumed_tokens_per_second FROM final UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), SECOND) AS bucket, IF((SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM `cloud-llm-preview1.global._Default._Default` WHERE log_id = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request' AND resource.type = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/PublisherModel' AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), ''), r'^(gemini|claude)')), 'No requests in this window.', 'No inference request logs in this window. Turn on logging to see 1-second data.') AS model, 0 AS consumed_tokens_per_second FROM (SELECT 1) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM final)

IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.rawPredictDetails.usageMetadata.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens) AS INT64), 0) AS c_write_1h, IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.rawPredictDetails.usageMetadata.output_tokens) AS INT64), 0) AS c_out FROM `cloud-llm-preview1.global._Default._Default` WHERE log_id = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request' AND resource.type = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/PublisherModel' AND IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.method), '') IN ('GENERATE_CONTENT', 'STREAM_GENERATE_CONTENT', 'RAW_PREDICT', 'STREAM_RAW_PREDICT') AND IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), '') != 'count-tokens' AND severity = 'INFO' AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), ''), r'^(gemini|claude)')), t AS ( SELECT r.*, IF(is_google, g_prompt + g_tool - 0.9 * LEAST(g_cached, g_prompt + g_tool) + g_out + g_thoughts, c_in + IFNULL(cfg.cache_read_weight, 0.1) * c_read + 1.25 * GREATEST(c_write - c_write_1h, 0) + 2 * c_write_1h + 5 * c_out) AS consumed, IF(is_google, g_cached, c_read) AS cache_read, IF(is_google, GREATEST(g_prompt + g_tool, g_cached), c_in + c_read + c_write) AS all_input, CASE WHEN traffic_type = 'PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT' THEN 'PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT' WHEN traffic_type != '' AND LOGICAL_OR(traffic_type = 'PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT') OVER (PARTITION BY model) AND IF(is_google, request_type NOT IN ('dedicated', 'shared'), request_type = 'batch') THEN 'PT_SPILLOVER' ELSE traffic_type END AS traffic_class FROM r LEFT JOIN cfg USING (model)), l AS (SELECT timestamp, CONCAT(model, CASE traffic_class WHEN 'ON_DEMAND' THEN ' standard PayGo' WHEN 'ON_DEMAND_PRIORITY' THEN ' priority PayGo' WHEN 'ON_DEMAND_FLEX' THEN ' flex PayGo' WHEN 'ON_DEMAND_OFFPEAK' THEN ' offpeak PayGo' WHEN 'PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT' THEN ' Provisioned Throughput' WHEN 'PT_SPILLOVER' THEN ' PT spillover' ELSE CONCAT(' ', traffic_class) END) AS series, consumed FROM t WHERE traffic_class NOT IN ('', 'PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT', 'PT_SPILLOVER')), ranked AS (SELECT series, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(consumed) DESC, series) AS rk FROM l GROUP BY series), s AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(l.timestamp, SECOND) AS second, IF(ranked.rk <= 15, l.series, 'other') AS series, SUM(l.consumed) AS consumed FROM l JOIN ranked USING (series) GROUP BY second, series), w AS (SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 200 THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 2000 THEN 10 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 12000 THEN 60 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 60000 THEN 300 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 180000 THEN 900 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 720000 THEN 3600 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 4320000 THEN 21600 ELSE 86400 END AS b FROM s) SELECT TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(second), b) * b) AS bucket, series AS model_traffic_type, SUM(consumed) / MAX(b) AS consumed_tokens_per_second FROM w GROUP BY bucket, series ORDER BY bucket, series) SELECT bucket, model_traffic_type, consumed_tokens_per_second FROM final UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), SECOND) AS bucket, IF((SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM `cloud-llm-preview1.global._Default._Default` WHERE log_id = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request' AND resource.type = 'aiplatform.googleapis.com/PublisherModel' AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(IFNULL(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.model_user_id), ''), r'^(gemini|claude)')), 'No pay-as-you-go traffic in this window.', 'No inference request logs in this window. Turn on logging to see 1-second data.') AS model_traffic_type, 0 AS consumed_tokens_per_second FROM (SELECT 1) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM final)

TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, SECOND) AS second, response_code, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM e GROUP BY second, response_code), w AS (SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 200 THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 2000 THEN 10 WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(second) OVER (), MIN(second) OVER (), SECOND) <= 12000 THEN FROM s) SELECT TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(second), b) * b) AS bucket, SUM(IF(response_code = '200', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_200, SUM(IF(response_code = '400', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_400, SUM(IF(response_code = '403', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_403, SUM(IF(response_code = '404', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_404, SUM(IF(response_code = '429', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_429, SUM(IF(response_code = '499', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_499, SUM(IF(response_code = '500', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_500, SUM(IF(response_code = '503', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_503, SUM(IF(response_code = '504', requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_504, SUM(IF(response_code NOT IN ('200', '400', '403', '404', '429', '499', '500', '503', '504'), requests, 0)) / MAX(b) AS code_other FROM w GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

widget.title: Provisioned Throughput

sectionHeader.subtitle: Provisioned Throughput is a fixed-cost monthly subscription or weekly service that reserves throughput for supported generative AI models on Vertex AI.

widget.title: Provisioned Throughput Utilization

text.content:
[Provisioned Throughput](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/provisioned-throughput) ensures available capacity for Vertex AI model traffic.

If utilization is high and it's likely that future traffic for critical model requests will increase, it may make sense to [buy more provisioned throughput](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/purchase-provisioned-throughput). 

You can view character and token throughput for individual models on the [Provisioned Throughput page in your Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/provisioned-throughput/utilization-summary).
